title: Temporary Total and Individual Unemployability Months Inside a Disability Compensation Restoration
content:
**Rule.** The restoration months of a Disability Compensation restoration priced from the 100 percent tier are:

| Decision history shows | Months priced from the 100 percent tier |
|---|---|
| A temporary total rating and no individual unemployability | The temporary total months that fall within the restoration months, each at the temporary total rate |
| Individual unemployability and no temporary total rating | The individual unemployability months that fall within the restoration months, each at the individual unemployability rate |
| Both | Both sets together, but no more than the restoration months |
| Neither | None |

A month so priced takes the temporary total rate (3938.58) or the individual unemployability rate (3938.58) in place of the veteran-alone rate, and its additions from the 100 percent tier — spouse 220.30, spouse aid and attendance 201.41, child 146.10, school child 472.95, parent 176.88. Every other restoration month takes its additions from the award's own tier.

**Months falling within the restoration months.**

- *Temporary total months within:* the whole months from the temporary total rating's effective date to the effective date of the decision on the same claim recording that the prior rating resumed, less the whole months from the temporary total rating's effective date to the restoration's start date; never fewer than nothing.
- *Individual unemployability months within:* the whole months from individual unemployability's effective date to today, less one for the current month, but no more than the restoration months; never fewer than nothing.

**Worked case (hypothetical; restoration start 1 March 2026; today 15 September 2026; 5 restoration months).** A temporary total rating effective 10 April 2026 with the prior rating resumed effective 10 July 2026: 3 whole months, less the whole months from 10 April 2026 to the start date of 1 March 2026, which are none because the start date comes first, gives 3 months at 3938.58 with 100 percent tier additions and 2 months at the veteran-alone rate. With individual unemployability instead, effective 20 June 2026: 2 whole months to today, less one, that is 1 month at 3938.58.
